title: A Visitor for the Room
author: N. M. Vane
blurb: Elodie Lockridge, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
